competitors.name: Vanta
competitors.notes: Purpose-built for automated compliance evidence collection across cloud, HR, and dev tools. Integrates with 100+ services, maps to SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, etc. Generates audit-ready reports and dashboards.
competitors.feature_overlap: Automated evidence gathering from AWS, GitHub, Jira, etc.; control mapping; continuous monitoring; audit report generation; security questionnaire automation.
competitors.pricing: Starts at ~$7,000/year (based on company size and frameworks).
competitors.market_positioning: All-in-one trust management platform for startups and mid-market.

competitors.name: Drata
competitors.notes: Direct competitor with similar automated evidence collection, continuous control monitoring, and audit readiness. Strong integrations with cloud, HR, and developer tools.
competitors.feature_overlap: Automated evidence collection, control mapping, auditor collaboration, risk management, questionnaire automation.
competitors.market_positioning: Continuous compliance automation for fast-growing companies.

competitors.name: Secureframe
competitors.notes: Automated evidence collection, personnel and vendor management, audit support. Integrates with AWS, GCP, GitHub, etc.
competitors.feature_overlap: Evidence collection, continuous monitoring, policy templates, auditor access, questionnaire automation.
competitors.market_positioning: Compliance automation for startups and SMBs.

competitors.name: Thoropass (formerly Laika)
competitors.notes: Combines compliance automation with audit services. Platform collects evidence, maps controls, and provides auditor access.
competitors.feature_overlap: Automated evidence gathering, control mapping, audit management, penetration testing add-on.

competitors.name: Hyperproof
competitors.notes: GRC platform with automated evidence collection, continuous control monitoring, and audit management. Integrates with many cloud and SaaS tools.
competitors.feature_overlap: Evidence collection, control mapping, risk register, audit workflows, dashboard reporting.
competitors.market_positioning: Continuous compliance operations for mid-market and enterprise.

competitors.name: AuditBoard
competitors.notes: Enterprise GRC platform with evidence collection, audit management, SOX, and operational audits. More focused on internal audit teams but covers evidence automation.
competitors.feature_overlap: Evidence collection, workpaper management, control testing, reporting.
competitors.market_positioning: Connected risk platform for enterprise audit, risk, and compliance.

competitors.name: LogicGate Risk Cloud
competitors.notes: GRC platform with customizable workflows for evidence collection, control monitoring, and audit management. Integrates with various data sources.
competitors.feature_overlap: Evidence collection, control testing, risk assessment, reporting.
competitors.market_positioning: Agile GRC platform for risk and compliance.

competitors.name: Onspring
competitors.notes: GRC software with automated evidence collection, continuous monitoring, and audit management. No-code platform.
competitors.feature_overlap: Evidence collection, control testing, issue tracking, dashboards.
competitors.market_positioning: Flexible GRC solutions for mid-market and enterprise.

competitors.name: StandardFusion
competitors.notes: GRC platform with evidence collection, control mapping, and audit management. Integrates with cloud services.
competitors.feature_overlap: Evidence collection, control monitoring, risk management, vendor assessments.

competitors.name: ZenGRC
competitors.notes: GRC platform by Reciprocity (now part of Riskonnect). Automated evidence collection, control mapping, audit readiness.
competitors.feature_overlap: Evidence collection, control monitoring, audit trails, reporting.

competitors.name: AWS Audit Manager
competitors.notes: Native AWS service that automates evidence collection for AWS resources. Maps to frameworks like SOC 2, PCI DSS. Limited to AWS ecosystem; does not cover GitHub, HR systems, etc.
competitors.feature_overlap: Automated evidence collection from AWS services, control mapping, audit-ready reports.
competitors.market_positioning: Cloud-native compliance evidence for AWS customers.

competitors.name: Azure Policy & Compliance Manager
competitors.notes: Microsoft's compliance tools for Azure. Can assess and collect evidence for regulatory standards. Limited to Azure ecosystem.
competitors.feature_overlap: Evidence collection from Azure resources, compliance dashboards.

competitors.name: Eramba
competitors.notes: Open-source GRC platform with risk management, compliance, and audit modules. Evidence collection is manual or via API; lacks pre-built integrations with cloud services for automated evidence gathering.
competitors.feature_overlap: Control mapping, audit trails, document management. No automated evidence collection from AWS/GitHub.
competitors.pricing: Free community edition, enterprise edition paid.
competitors.market_positioning: Open-source GRC for organizations with technical teams.

competitors.name: ComplianceForge
competitors.notes: Provides policy templates and control documentation, not automated evidence collection. Could be used alongside manual processes.
competitors.feature_overlap: Control documentation, policy templates. No evidence automation.

competitors.name: Scytale
competitors.notes: Compliance automation platform with evidence collection, integrations, and audit support. Focus on SOC 2, ISO 27001.
competitors.feature_overlap: Automated evidence collection, continuous monitoring, auditor access.

substitutes.name: Manual spreadsheets and shared drives
substitutes.notes: Current workaround: point-in-time screenshots, Excel trackers, calendar reminders. No automation, high manual effort.

substitutes.name: Consultancies (A-LIGN, Schellman, etc.)
substitutes.notes: Offer managed compliance services where they manually collect evidence and prepare for audits. High cost, not scalable.

substitutes.name: Zapier/Make integrations + database
substitutes.notes: Could build custom automation to pull data from systems into a central repository, but requires significant setup and maintenance, no built-in control mapping or audit reporting.

substitutes.name: SIEM tools (Splunk, Datadog)
substitutes.notes: Collect logs and security events but not designed for compliance evidence organization, control mapping, or audit report generation. Partial overlap.

summary: The market for automated compliance evidence collection is crowded with well-funded, purpose-built SaaS platforms (Vanta, Drata, Secureframe, Thoropass, Hyperproof, etc.) and established GRC suites (AuditBoard, LogicGate, ZenGRC). These tools directly address the JTBD by integrating with cloud, HR, and developer tools to automatically gather evidence, map to controls, and generate audit-ready reports. Platform-native tools (AWS Audit Manager) provide partial competition within their ecosystems. Open-source alternatives (Eramba) lack automated integrations. The competitive landscape is mature, with multiple players offering similar feature sets and pricing tiers. A new entrant would face significant headwinds unless offering a radically different approach or targeting an underserved niche (e.g., specific industry or micro-businesses).
